Manto.FreeDisk - where did my disk space go?
================================================

Nothing to install: extract and run.

  mfd-cli           the answer, read: the colored grid, -big 10, filters,
                    -json. English is embedded - it works alone.
  mfd-tui           the answer, navigated: the two-panel navigator.

Want more? install.sh (same folder) publishes both as user commands
(~/.local/bin - make sure it is in your PATH) and drops the other six
languages in ~/.config/mfd/lang.

Verify the download: the .sha256 file that rides next to this archive.

License: AGPL-3.0 - see LICENSE. The full story (FAQ, architecture,
the experiment) lives in the docs/ folder of the repository.
